11.description: Saskatoon approved a discretionary use application for a commercial school at 119 105th Street East, allowing it to operate with up to 30 students and 5 staff.

12.description: This item proposes rezoning 1224 College Drive in Varsity View to allow for future 3-6 story mixed-use development, aligning with the College Quarter Plan and city growth goals.

chips.text: Applicant Wiggins Holings Limited Partnership seeks rezoning.
No public comments or concerns were received regarding the rezoning.

13.description: An application proposed to re-designate 133 108th Street West in Sutherland for medium-density residential, allowing up to six dwelling units. City administration and the Municipal Planning Commission recommended denial.

chips.text: Applicant argued the 26-year-old local area plan is irrelevant to current needs.
Administration warned approval could set a city-wide precedent for infill density.
Six residents raised concerns; Strong Towns YXC and applicant supported the rezoning.
Housing affordability pressures fall heavily on renters, students, and low-income households.
Administration will propose rescinding outdated local area plans in the future.

15.description: The committee recommends City Council consider Bylaw No. 10162 for rezoning 133 108th Street West, after a prior related bylaw failed.

14.description: Saskatoon is considering proposed amendments to its zoning bylaw for digital and project development signs, addressing community concerns about traffic safety, clutter, and impacts.

chips.text: Councillor Donauer criticized the public survey questions as leading
Councillor Donauer questioned why the bylaw bypassed a GPC committee review.
Residents expressed concerns with digital sign brightness and driver distraction.

16.description: Saskatoon proposes new development application fees for wall, free-standing, and project signs, aiming for full cost recovery based on review time.

chips.text: Applicants for wall, free-standing, and project development signs will pay new fees.
